title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Commercial Promotion - CommercialCampaign
description: A commercial promotion campaign, e.g. a voucher or discount campaign run across several commercial spaces (edintpro:CommercialCampaign). This ontology's own CommercialSpace declaration is a pointer (rdfs:isDefinedBy) to edint-censo-locales's real CommercialSpace, not a separate definition; not re-modeled here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CommercialCampaign'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

identifier.description: Property. A human-readable code identifying the campaign in the source data (dct:identifier), e.g. 'CAMP-2025-CH-001'.

startDate.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. The date and time the campaign starts (schema:startDate).

endDate.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. The date and time the campaign ends (schema:endDate).

hasCommercialCampaignType.description: Property. Type of commercial campaign, from the CommercialCampaignType controlled vocabulary (edintpro:hasCommercialCampaignType).

includesCommercialSpace.description: Relationship. The CommercialSpace(s) (edint-censo-locales) that have joined this campaign (edintpro:includesCommercialSpace). NOTE: the source ontology's own real example data uses a different, undeclared property name ('includes') for this relationship instead; modeled here under the formally declared name -- see standard-metadata.yaml.

locatedInZone.description: Relationship. The zone (e.g. edint-zona-regulatoria's RegulatedZone with zoneType=EconomicInterestZone) this campaign is located in (edintpro:locatedInZone).

budget.description: Property. An estimate of expenditure for the campaign (edintpro:budget). The source ontology does not constrain the currency/unit.

numberOfCommercialSpaces.description: Property. The number of commercial spaces joined to the campaign (edintpro:numberOfCommercialSpaces).
